profile.headline: Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Infrastructure
profile.summary:
Hey! Great to have you here. 
I love meeting new people, and helping others any way I can. Technology has been my favorite medium to accomplish that. 

I’ve worked as a software engineer for 6 years, most recently at Capital One. In that role, I've been responsible for designing and implementing batch data pipelines with data outputs to drive Capital One card partnerships. 

Before that at VMware, I worked on a distributed system leveraging cloud APIs to bring cloud insights to the customers of a SaaS multi-cloud management platform. I handled 2 billion cloud resources daily on a distributed API data collection system at a large scale.

Please reach out! I would love to get to know you.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tines is the complete environment for enterprise AI, trusted by organizations like Reddit, SAP, Mars, Fin and Headspace. Tines 3B, launched in 2026, gives teams a safe, scalable way to turn their expertise into software, whatever their technical background.

Since its founding in 2018, Tines has enabled over 600 customers to run their most important work, where reliability and security aren't optional.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and delivered ETL data infrastructure improvements adopted by 300+ engineers, including fixed-
width schema validation across 10+ production GL pipelines reconciling $100M+ in monthly credit card
transaction volume.

Architected end-to-end PySpark pipelines on AWS Glue processing $50M+ in monthly partner transactions, eliminating 10+ hours of manual reconciliation per cycle.

Cut pipeline runtime from 12 hours to 45 minutes with LLM-assisted code generation and GitHub Copilot integration.

Defined reusable architecture patterns and mentored engineers on distributed pipeline design, reducing new pipeline delivery time from months to weeks.

Key technologies: PySpark, AWS Glue, Python, SQL
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Distributed Systems · Systems Design · PySpark

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Scaled distributed data ingestion processing 1M+ cloud API jobs per minute across AWS, Azure, and GCP,
driving architectural decisions on Kafka topic design, microservice decomposition, and schema to enable cost
and resource tracking for 10,000+ customers.

Eliminated $100K+/month in infrastructure spend by designing an in-memory CloudTrail log processing solution replacing costly ElasticSearch clusters.

Built a Ruby microservice on AWS EKS with Istio service mesh for real-time container metadata ingestion.Led a 4-person team through system design and full migration from legacy monolith to microservices.

Overhauled cloud billing parsing across 1B+ daily cloud resources, uncovering $10M+/month of previously untracked EC2 spend per customer.

Migrated 7-microservice Kubernetes environment to AWS EKS with zero downtime across 30,000 production containers. 

Secured ElastiCache clusters via phased rollout with distributed tracing and automated rollback, resulting in zero service interruptions.

Key technologies: Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS EKS, Ruby, Docker, Terraform, distributed systems, microservices,
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Databases · SQL · Jenkins · Redis · Docker Products · Microservices · Ruby on Rails · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Distributed Systems · Ruby · Systems Design · Cloud Computing · Kubernetes

positions.description: Skills: Jenkins · Docker Products · Ruby · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching assistant for CS1800 Discrete Structures.

I led weekly recitations to teach review material and giving weekly quizzes. 30+ students in 2 class sections every semester. I learned and practiced classroom management, efficiently switching between large-group and individual focus.

I held weekly office hours 3 times a week, to provide direct one-on-one guidance and mentorship to fellow students. This was the most engaging part of this role; I learned so much personally, and felt pure joy seeing students go from discouragement and confusion to epiphany and excitement.
positions.insights: Skills: Classroom Management · Teaching · Discrete Mathematics · Mentoring

positions.title: Test Automation Co-op
positions.description:
I worked alongside Blueport's QA/DevOps team to build out the automated testing infrastructure on bespoke eCommerce platforms for furniture companies.

I introduced intelligent retry on a .NET automated testing framework. It led to fewer faulty test results and drove confidence in testing reports throughout the whole company. Importantly, it also reduced test suite runtimes by 30%. 

I regularly engaged with 3 other development teams and took initiative to promote test-driven development throughout the codebase.
